# axual_topic_config (List Resource)

Lists topic configurations (a topic on an environment).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Only resources on this environment. Takes the environment's ID, short name or exact name.
- `owners` (String) Only configurations of topics owned by this group. Takes the group's ID or its exact name.
- `topic` (String) Only resources of this topic. Takes the topic's ID or exact name.
